Job Description
Join our team for a unique opportunity working directly with one of the world's largest technology companies. As a BIM Coordinator, you will collaborate with our BIM team to maintain accurate Revit and CAD files, being the site-level contact for BIM content review, approval, management, and maintenance.

Your responsibilities include playing a crucial part in coordinating the delivery and maintaining CAD/BIM content for data center projects, utilizing professional tools and processes to ensure accuracy and compliance. This role will require the ability to multitask and work well with our team and a variety of people.
As a BIM Coordinator, you will also provide support to the CAD/BIM team during various project milestones and in a variety of ways based on current demand. You will lead closeout efforts, coordinate with stakeholders, perform model health checks, incorporate retrofit projects into existing models, and perform general model maintenance / drafting.

Working collaboratively with others.
Having ownership in the work you do.
Using your talents to positively affect communities.

Ability to contribute and work well on a team
Flexibility and desire to perform various tasks as needs change
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills
Proficiency in Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, and other relevant software tools
Proven experience in BIM management and drafting
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and work well within a team
Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality work and continuous improvement

Industrial Compute is building the world's most advanced AI infrastructure. Working alongside our capital partners, engineering teams, and construction organizations, we design and deliver large-scale, mission-critical compute campuses that power the next generation of AI. Our Design organization brings together engineering, construction, and digital design to ensure facilities are coordinated, constructible, and optimized from the earliest planning phases through deployment.

We are seeking a BIM Coordinator / BIM Designer to support the planning and design of large-scale industrial and mission-critical facilities. In this role, you will develop, coordinate, and maintain multidisciplinary BIM models across Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Architectural, and Structural disciplines, enabling early design validation, constructability reviews, equipment planning, and cross-functional coordination.
You will partner closely with internal engineering teams, external design consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders to produce coordinated BIM deliverables that improve design quality, reduce project risk, and support efficient execution across Industrial Compute's global infrastructure portfolio.

Develop and maintain conceptual and schematic BIM models for large-scale industrial and MEP-intensive facilities.
Coordinate BIM models across Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Architectural, and Structural disciplines.
Create and maintain federated models used for design reviews, spatial coordination, constructability analysis, and clash detection.
Model major building systems including equipment layouts, utility corridors, electrical rooms, mechanical rooms, structural framing, site infrastructure, and architectural constraints.
Coordinate equipment clearances, maintenance access, routing zones, shafts, risers, utility entrances, and major MEP pathways.
Translate engineering sketches, basis-of-design documents, equipment lists, one-line diagrams, and planning documentation into coordinated BIM models.
Support early design activities including test-fit studies, routing evaluations, phasing plans, utility coordination, and design option analysis.
Maintain BIM standards including model organization, file naming conventions, worksets, shared coordinates, view templates, and model health.
Support multidisciplinary coordination using Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM 360, Revizto, or similar collaboration platforms.
Prepare model views, coordination packages, exports, and documentation for design reviews and stakeholder meetings.
Support model-based quantity takeoffs, equipment tracking, asset information, room data, and design progress reporting.
Review consultant and contractor BIM deliverables for quality, coordination, completeness, and compliance with project BIM standards.
Help maintain digital design assets that support planning, design development, construction coordination, and operational handoff.
Discipline Focus Areas
Civil BIM Designer
Develop site models including grading concepts, access roads, utility corridors, stormwater systems, underground duct banks, and civil infrastructure.
Coordinate civil infrastructure with building footprints, substations, generators, cooling equipment, underground utilities, and site constraints.
Experience with Civil 3D, ArcGIS, Revit Site, and utility modeling is preferred.
Electrical BIM Designer
Develop conceptual and schematic models for substations, switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, cable tray, busway, duct banks, grounding systems, and major power distribution infrastructure.
Coordinate electrical equipment clearances, cable routing, service entrances, and access requirements with architectural, structural, mechanical, and civil disciplines.
Experience with Revit Electrical, AutoCAD, Navisworks, and interpreting one-line diagrams is preferred.
Mechanical BIM Designer
Develop models for mechanical equipment, chilled water systems, hydronic piping, airside systems, ductwork, pumps, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, heat exchangers, tanks, and central utility plants.
Coordinate mechanical routing, maintenance access, pipe racks, structural supports, overhead zones, and major penetrations.
Experience with Revit Mechanical, Navisworks, and industrial piping and duct coordination is preferred.
Architectural / Structural BIM Designer
Develop architectural and structural models including building shells, floor plans, slabs, structural steel, foundations, equipment pads, platforms, stairs, and access areas.
Coordinate architectural and structural constraints with MEP systems, utility entrances, equipment placement, and code-required clearances.
Experience with Revit Architecture, Revit Structure, AutoCAD, and Navisworks is preferred.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical field.
3+ years of BIM modeling, BIM coordination, drafting, or design technology experience.
Experience developing 3D models using Revit, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Inventor, SolidWorks, or comparable BIM/CAD platforms.
Experience supporting multidisciplinary coordination for complex industrial, infrastructure, or building projects.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, equipment layouts, design narratives, diagrams, and consultant deliverables.
Strong understanding of BIM standards, model organization, file management, and coordination workflows.

Experience supporting large-scale industrial, data center, manufacturing, utility, or other mission-critical infrastructure projects.
Experience developing conceptual and schematic design models in addition to construction documentation.
Strong understanding of multidisciplinary MEP coordination, equipment clearances, routing zones, and constructability considerations.
Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM 360, Navisworks, Revizto, Bluebeam, Civil 3D, ArcGIS, Dynamo, Python, or Autodesk Platform Services.
Experience supporting model automation, asset management, data extraction, quantity takeoffs, and design reporting.
Experience coordinating with internal engineering organizations, external consultants, contractors, and owner representatives.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Architectural, and Structural engineering teams.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products.

We are seeking an experienced BIM Structural Specialist that performs complex drafting assignments requiring the application of standardized techniques. The design associate works independently and may direct efforts of less experienced staff. This position has diversified design experience, an ability to perform work of a greater complexity, and recommends design techniques and minor design changes to ensure the best approach to solve engineering and design needs.

· Develop and maintain structural LOD 200-400 BIM models in Autodesk Revit, including beams, columns, foundations, walls, and other key components.

· Prepare and update structural drawings, layouts, specifications, details, and schedules for design and construction documentation.

· Create and manage Revit families, templates, filters, and work sets to support project-specific needs and align with company standards.

· Collaborate with civil and process teams to integrate models across platforms such as Civil 3D and Plant 3D.

· Export models to RISA 3D and support structural analysis workflows.

· Generate accurate quantity takeoffs from BIM models to support cost estimation.

· Ensure all models and drawings comply with project requirements, codes (IBC, OSHA, PIP), and company standards.

· Maintain revision control of BIM models and drawing sets, and lead efforts in routing and transmittal of drawings using Bluebeam.

· Conduct quality reviews of models and documentation for accuracy, consistency, and constructability.

· Participate in project coordination meetings and conduct occasional site visits to verify field conditions and support issue resolution.

· Assist in the development of as-built models using 3D point cloud scans.

· Stay current with emerging design tools and techniques to enhance project delivery.

· Work closely with engineers in a collaborative, iterative design process.

· Provide training and mentorship to team members in BIM software and workflows.

· May supervise and review work of less experienced staff.

· May be required to work in various terrain and weather conditions on active construction sites.

· Working collaboratively with others.

· Having ownership in the work you do.

· Using your talents to positively affect communities.

· Collaborating with clients and coworkers to develop custom, impactful solutions.

· Playing an active role in project success—from scoping and design to management and delivery.

· Building meaningful relationships with clients across projects of all sizes.

· Working in a fast-paced environment where each day brings new challenges and opportunities.

· Committed to advancing team goals by engaging in diverse project work.

· Strong communication skills.

· Ability to contribute and work well with a team.

· Excellent interpersonal and problem-solving skills.

· Associate degree in a related field preferred.

· A minimum of eight years of experience using Autodesk Revit.

· Autodesk Certified Professional in Revit for Structural Design with experience working on industrial projects.

· Familiar with Navisworks and ACAD software.

KPF , an international architecture practice headquartered in New York City, is seeking a BIM Coordinator in the New York Area to assist and support the integration of BIM related technologies with KPF’s design and business processes on large high-profile projects.
This position requires previous professional experience with BIM technologies – i.e. Revit, Dynamo, Navisworks, etc. – and their application to the design, construction and fabrication phases of large, global and complex projects. The candidate should have between 5-7 years of architectural professional experience with strong documentation skills, experience on large-scale projects, and ability to be flexible and work well/collaborate with team members.
We seek an individual with expertise and interest in all aspects of AEC design technologies, and with aspirations to be leaders in the industry. The position involves direct interaction and communication with architectural teams, including leading training sessions and best practice implementation. Periodic interaction with senior KPF staff and clients in all aspects of BIM integration will be expected.

Assist with the development and updates to BIM protocols specific to the project.
Develop customized workflows to automate the monitoring and extraction of data from multiple models.
Collation of data and visualization for presentations.
Assist in organizing and running BIM-related meetings and managing project records.
BIM QA/QC & Compliance Management through ISO 19650.
Develop and implement a clash detection process for the project.
Provide BIM onboarding for new design team members.
Interface with software support engineers to quickly resolve more complex problems.
Assist with integration of cloud based collaborative technologies
Utilizes specialist knowledge to conduct complex modeling, data management, analysis and/or optimization for architectural designs.
Ensure project teams meet clients’ BIM requirements and delivery standards.
Perform audits to ensure health of the BIM model throughout the project cycle.
Acts as a leader and mentor by coaching and motivating project team members in the use of advanced Revit technologies.
Maintain current knowledge of design software, industry developments in integrated practice, and other applicable techniques.

Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in architecture, Engineering, or related field.
Minimum 5+ years in Revit – professional and/or specific academic BIM application.
Proficiency in Revit modeling, documentation and creative solutions.
Strong presentation skills and ability to clearly present information.
Experience with modeling applications Rhino, Visual Programming (Grasshopper/Dynamo), Enscape and VR, or Scripting Languages (i.e. Python, C#, C++, etc.) is a plus.

$85,000.00 - $105,000.00 Annual
Why KPF?
KPF’s mission is to elevate cities through impactful design, collaborating closely with the world’s most forward-thinking clients to create high performing, carefully crafted buildings that are unique to their physical, social, and environmental contexts.
Career Growth: Opportunities for training, development, and career progression.
Company Culture: Collaborative, high-performance environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k with company matching contributions, paid time off and other perks.

Applications submitted without a resume will not be considered.

Ontwerp slimme oplossingen en realiseer impactvolle verandering
‘Complexe gebouwen vragen om overzicht, precisie en gevoel voor samenwerking. In deze rol verbind jij architectuur , BIM en uitvoering. Ontwerpmodellen blijven continu in beweging. Juist die dynamiek maakt het werk interessant. Spreekt dat aan? Dan kom ik graag met jou in contact.’
— Sylvie Smeets – teammanager Architectuur
Werken bij Sweco betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Onze business unit Architectuur in Nederland bestaat uit 75 collega’s, verspreid over Maastricht, Eindhoven, Utrecht en Rotterdam. Binnen onze architectuurteams werk jij aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante gebouwen.

Denk aan renovatieprojecten voor MUMC, voor het Catharina Ziekenhuis en projecten voor het COA.(nieuwbouw voor CZE is nog een beetje pre-matuur, we hebben de opdracht nog niet) De teams bestaan uit architecten, modelleurs, kostendeskundigen, bestekschrijvers en directievoerders.

Samen werken zij aan ontwerpen waarin architectuur, techniek en uitvoering samenkomen.
Als BIM coördinator architectuur modelleer en coördineer jij het architectuurmodel. Ook voer jij clashcontroles uit en bespreek jij uitkomsten met opdrachtgevers, adviseurs en collega’s. Het architectuurmodel vormt vaak de basis voor andere disciplines. Daardoor vraagt deze rol om overzicht, flexibiliteit en gevoel voor ontwerpkwaliteit.

Modellen veranderen continu door nieuwe inzichten vanuit constructie, installaties of uitvoering. Precies daar ligt jouw toegevoegde waarde. Ook directievoering op de bouw kan onderdeel worden van jouw rol, als die ambitie er is.
Bij Sweco werk jij aan complexe projecten voor waar multidisciplinaire samenwerking staat centraal. Daardoor kijk jij verder dan alleen het model. Er is veel ruimte om mee te denken over BIM-systematiek, modelafstemming en slimme werkprocessen. Ook binnen het team is ruimte om vakkennis te delen, nieuwe verantwoordelijkheden op te pakken en verder te groeien binnen richting bijvoorbeeld BIM management of projectmanagement.

Dit is wat we jou bieden
Bij Sweco zit je goed. Dit mag je verwachten van een werkgever met het World-class Workplace label. Om te beginnen ontvang je conform CAO voor Architectenbureaus een goed salaris en 30 vakantiedagen. Daarnaast bieden we een thuiswerkvergoeding, vakantietoeslag, een circulaire thuiswerkplek en een goede pensioenregeling.
Daarnaast krijg je bij Sweco veel regie, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Over hoeveel je werkt, waar je werkt, hoe je werkt en wanneer je werkt. Binnen ons arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket heb je de keuze om te kiezen op welke manier jij reist. We stimuleren duurzame en actieve keuzes en belonen deze extra. Ook krijg je direct toegang tot onze eigen AI-omgeving SwecoGPT, tot de Sweco Academy voor zeer ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden, en tot ons vitaliteitsprogramma gericht op leefstijl en sport.
Naast uitdagend werk, support en middelen pakken we bij Sweco ook graag uit als het gaat om ontspanning en lol. We willen graag dat je met veel plezier naar je werk gaat. Denk aan een tweedaags event voor alle nieuwe collega’s, de dagelijkse Fika’s op kantoor, events op jouw vestiging, en activiteiten vanuit Jong Sweco en de lokale personeelsverenigingen.
Solliciteer op deze functie
Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via de button ‘solliciteren’. We kijken uit naar je cv en motivatie!
Neem bij inhoudelijke vragen of interesse in Sweco contact op met Sylvie Smeets, teammanager Architectuur via +31 6 40 63 57 81 of sylvie.smeets@sweco.nl . Vragen over het sollicitatieproces kun je stellen aan Bert aan den Toorn via +31 6 39 44 05 98 of bert.aandentoorn@sweco.nl .
Afgeronde hbo-opleiding bouwkunde, architectuur of vergelijkbaar.
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als BIM coördinator, BIM modelleur of vergelijkbaar binnen architectuur.
Ruime ervaring met Revit en het coördineren van , BIM-modellen.
Ervaring met de dynamiek van een architectenbureau, waar ontwerpen en modellen continu bewegen.
Vermogen om makkelijk te schakelen met architecten, adviseurs, opdrachtgevers en uitvoerende partijen.

C.F. Møller Architects is one of Scandinavia’s leading architectural firms and has been synonymous with award-winning architecture in the Nordic countries and around the world for over 100 years. Our work combines experience, innovation, and Nordic values to create architectural quality that meets both sustainable and aesthetic standards. In this way, we create solutions with lasting value—for clients, users, and society.

C.F. Møller Architects has also had a presence in Berlin for the past seven years. In our office, located on a bright top floor in Schöneberg between Gleisdreieckpark and the Neue Nationalgalerie, an international team of over 35 architects works on a wide variety of projects.

For our Berlin office, we are looking for a BIM Specialist Coordinator to join and strengthen our project teams You will bring sound technical expertise in Revit and Autodesk Construction Cloud.
